mechanism.summary: Reuse a hidden per-bytecode-site for-in key array only when the target and every link in its prototype chain remain the same ordinary ObjectRef with the same enumerable-key layout.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility is derived solely from live value kinds, object identities, prototype links, and layout revisions. It does not inspect source paths, benchmark names, checksums, or iteration counts. Proxies, arrays, functions, typed arrays, module namespaces, and every changed or unsupported chain retain the canonical enumeration path.
semantic_risks: preserving ECMAScript for-in key order and prototype shadowing across ordinary object chains
invalidating before an add, delete, descriptor or enumerable-flag change can expose a stale key list
detecting target or inherited prototype replacement before reusing a cached list
keeping the existing per-key live enumerable check so mutations during an active loop remain observable
falling back before any Proxy or exotic-object observable operation is skipped
